rst31-v2-r2-svc-q001.objective: Recognize things that do not belong in food.
rst31-v2-r2-svc-q001.stem: A piece of paper is found in a dish. Which view of a foreign object is correct?
options: It is not a foreign object without an injury
Only metal can be a foreign object
Soft items are not foreign objects
Check it as a foreign object because it does not belong in the food
rst31-v2-r2-svc-q001.explanation: Foreign objects should not be in that food. Hardness or whether injury occurred does not alone decide the definition.
reasons: Treat it as foreign before injury occurs
Paper and other nonmetals are also included
It meets the definition of not belonging in the food

rst31-v2-r2-svc-q002.objective: Distinguish hard and soft foreign-object examples.
rst31-v2-r2-svc-q002.stem: Which grouping fits the source examples for an inspection list?
options: Everything is hard, so no soft category is needed
Everything is soft, so injury risk can be ignored
Stone, metal, glass and hard plastic are hard; insects, hair, vinyl and paper are soft
Stone and metal are soft; hair and paper are hard
rst31-v2-r2-svc-q002.explanation: The examples distinguish hard and soft objects. Softness does not remove the need to respond to contamination.
reasons: It ignores hard objects and injury risk
Both sets of representative examples are correctly matched
It reverses hard and soft examples

rst31-v2-r2-svc-q003.objective: Reconsider person, place and timing in difficult complaints.
rst31-v2-r2-svc-q003.stem: Strong dissatisfaction remains despite responding with the manager. What should be considered?
options: Time always solves it, so stop reporting
Changing location removes the need to check the complaint
Consider changing the person, place or timing and apologize again at departure if needed
Only repeat the same explanation louder
rst31-v2-r2-svc-q003.explanation: Reconsider the response with the manager when one method fails. Changes do not replace checking the issue or needed apologies.
reasons: Do not assume time always resolves it
The complaint still needs checking after moving
It considers response options and needed apologies
Repeating loudly alone does not reconsider the method
